name: clicktime-cloudflare-blog
description: A single-Worker Cloudflare blog with D1 storage and queued link scans.

scripts.test: node --test test/scanners.test.mjs test/email.test.mjs test/joe-sandbox.test.mjs cloudflare/security.test.mjs cloudflare/worker.test.mjs
scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply clicktime-blog-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply clicktime-blog-db --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
